goal.objective: Instantiate the validated StegGate Audit Kit against the first named non-synthetic consequential boundary only after its authority model is durably established.
success_predicates: A named non-synthetic consequential target is durably referenced
A reviewable authority model is durably referenced
ara management/first-boundary-activation.json is READY and validates
A finite bounded implementation claim is then created under ara issue #13
failure_predicates: A synthetic fixture is misrepresented as a real consequence boundary
Implementation begins without a durable target and authority model
Heartbeat or worker availability is treated as execution authority

task.derivation_reason: Audit Kit and independent verifier prerequisites are complete; first real consequence-boundary work is the canonical dependency-gated successor.

activation.recheck_trigger: management/first-boundary-activation.json state becomes READY and validates

completion.next_authorized_action: Re-evaluate only when the named target and authority model are durably present and the ara activation validator reports READY; then create a finite issue #13 implementation claim.
terminal_when: Real-boundary evidence is captured and independently reconstructed
Applicable #63/#64/#65 consequence findings are durably updated

block.recheck_trigger: consequential_target_ref and authority_model_ref become non-null, activation state READY, validator PASS
block.escalation_condition: HUMAN_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED only if the missing authority model itself requires an explicit human decision
